CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  country TEXT NOT NULL,            -- ISO code: DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE
  phone TEXT,
  is_test INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
  deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,           -- audio, outdoor, kitchen, office
  price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
  weight_grams INTEGER,
  deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,     -- sum of the order's items
  coupon_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
  paid_at TEXT,
  deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE refunds (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL          -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
);

  weight_grams INTEGER,
  deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,     -- sum of the order's items
  coupon_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
  paid_at TEXT,
  deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE refunds (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL          -- 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
);

How many refunds have been issued for each reason? Count refunds without a reason under 'none'. Return the reason and the number of refunds.

reference.content: SELECT COALESCE(r.reason, 'none') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS refunds FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_test = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(r.reason, 'none')
